agent.tool_access: Explicit stdio MCP SDK within generic host tools; fresh child session per task, A1 index follow-up in same session; A4 discovery in another fresh session.
agent.compaction: See host usage records; no conversation memory shared across arms.
agent.usage: host_reported_token_count; child request sums independently reconcile to cumulative totals

comfyui.output_isolation_limit: MCP downloads/state are separate; pilot used one shared raw ComfyUI output directory. Formal plan requires separate per-task output directories.
comfyui.cache: A1/A2 each preceded by execution-cache reset/model unload plus 4-step organizer warmup. A4-B KSampler and seven other text-generation nodes were cached.

limitations: No separately retained pre-task byte snapshot for pilot templates; final bytes match the independent reconstruction/source.
Global CLI profile initialization may have occurred for one --version and one --help before isolation; evidence records the uncertainty.
Pilot backend observation is incomplete. Audit v2 was separately validated after the pilot and does not retroactively fill old measurements.
publication_note: inputs_lock_sha256 is the original recorded lock; published_inputs_lock_sha256 checks the public derivative. Runtime hashes are not rewritten to match redacted publication data.
